architecture.title: Service Architecture
architecture.decoupled.title: Decoupled Service Architecture
architecture.decoupled.description: WorkspaceService is the authoritative source for files, documents and tabs. ServiceContainer remains a compatibility registry while the remaining modules are migrated.

architecture.module.editor: CodeMirror 6 with authoritative documents, tabs, dirty state and external conflicts. Real LSP integration is still pending.
architecture.module.explorer: Manages workspace file nodes with dynamic rendering and synchronization.
architecture.module.terminal: Persistent PTY terminal with multiple sessions, streaming, interactive input, resize, interruption and system-detected shell profiles.
architecture.module.tasks: Authoritative tasks and problems panel with execution-specific channels and diagnostics linked to workspace files.
architecture.module.git: Source Control connected to the real Git Host: status, diff, stage, commits, branches, stashes and remotes.
architecture.module.task-host: Task Host in the main process: JSONC configuration, package.json scripts, dependency graphs, limited concurrency, cancellation and problem matchers.
architecture.module.git-host: Git Host in the main process with shell disabled, closed arguments, mutation queue, timeouts, output limits and credential prompts disabled.
architecture.module.ipc: Asynchronous communication layer between Main process and Renderer channels.
architecture.module.ext-host: Planned: isolated utility process with a capability broker. Workspace extensions are discovered but not executed in the renderer.
